rows.title: Fall Reception
rows.description:
Join us for our Fall Reception on Saturday, October 10, from 6–8 p.m. Free and open to the public.

Step into five new exhibitions, enjoy light refreshments, and spend the evening wandering through galleries full of new work and good conversation. Bring friends, bring family, or just yourself, and celebrate the arts and fall with UCR ARTS!

This program is supported by the College of Humanities, Arts, and Social Sciences at UC Riverside, and by the City of Riverside.

rows.title: Fall Reception
rows.description:
Save the date! Come see our new exhibition Dispatches: The Photography of Douglas McCulloh opening September 12!

Join us as we celebrate this exhibition at our Fall Reception on Saturday, October 10, 6-8 p.m. Free and open to the public. RSVPs encouraged. 

🔗 Visit the link in bio to RSVP!

Exhibitions on view: 
-Dispatches: The Photography of Douglas McCulloh, 1990–2025, the first-ever retrospective of McCulloh’s nearly four-decade career.
-A Solid Sense of Who You Are: Selections from the Museum Collection, pulled from McCulloh’s own essays, interests, and friendships.
-The Great Picture: Revisiting the Legacy Project, the project that set the Guinness World Record for the world’s largest print photograph.
-Won Ju Lim: The Vast Structure of Recollection, installations that turn the experience of memory into something you can physically walk through.
-Heather Cleary: Thresholds, one striking photograph brought to life with miniature clay figures.
rows.location: UCR ARTS: California Museum of Photography

rows.title: Fall Reception
rows.description:
You’re invited to join us as we celebrate five new exhibitions at our Fall Reception on Saturday, October 10, 6-8 p.m. Free and open to the public. RSVPs encouraged.

Won Jum Lim: The Vast Structure of Recollection is among the exhibitions being celebrated. Memory is rarely a precise record of the past; rather, it is a creative act of reconstruction. This understanding of memory’s fluid nature is a hallmark of Marcel Proust’s writing, the source of the exhibition’s title and frequent inspiration for artist Won Ju Lim.

Bring friends, bring family, or just yourself, and celebrate the arts and fall with UCR ARTS!
rows.location: UCR ARTS, 3834 Main Street, Riverside, CA 92501

rows.title: Fall Reception
rows.description:
Save the Date! Join us for our Fall Reception on Saturday, October 10, from 6–8 p.m. Free and open to the public. 

Step into five new exhibitions including Won Ju Lim: The Vast Structure of Recollection, which brings together three chapters of Lim’s artistic practice. The exhibition includes Proustian Bedrooms, That Sense of Complexity…, and a new site-specific installation. Created especially for this exhibition, a new installation investigates the physical and spectral traces of the gallery itself–a former turn-of-the-century Rouse’s department store–exploring the museum site as a repository for residues of the past.
